sct.prompt: Use skills/needs-analysis/SKILL.md in this checkout to start a SCTKit benchmark. Start from a clinical scenario, hypothesis and new information. Specify the response scale and source of the reference distribution. Ask me one question at a time and save the agreed decisions in my benchmark workspace.
sct.capability: A local scoring adapter supports concordance. Provide an authorized distribution and identify whether it comes from experts or a synthetic reference.

cpc.prompt: Use skills/needs-analysis/SKILL.md in this checkout to start a CPCKit benchmark. Select the CPC variant first: differential diagnosis, management, text questions or image questions. Ask me one question at a time and save the agreed decisions in my benchmark workspace.
cpc.capability: The staged differential adapter accepts diagnosis aliases and uses reciprocal rank. Other variants need their own case and scoring contracts.

medagentbench.prompt: Use skills/needs-analysis/SKILL.md in this checkout to start a MedAgentKit benchmark. Describe the clinical workflow, permitted FHIR tools and the chart state used to judge completion. Ask me one question at a time and save the agreed decisions in my benchmark workspace.
medagentbench.capability: The local FHIR example builds and runs synthetic chart tasks. The original MedAgentBench has its own runtime and access requirements.

rexrank.prompt: Use skills/needs-analysis/SKILL.md in this checkout to start a RadiologyKit benchmark. Define the intended report task and specify the authorized images, reference reports and report-quality judge. Ask me one question at a time and save the agreed decisions in my benchmark workspace.
rexrank.capability: The skills support report-task planning. Implement or supply the report scorer before execution.

custom.prompt: Use skills/needs-analysis/SKILL.md in this checkout to start a custom benchmark. Start with my clinical task and intended use. Help me specify the inputs, expected output, reference material and scoring contract. Ask me one question at a time and save the agreed decisions in my benchmark workspace.
custom.capability: The implementation plan records which data loader and scorer are available and any additional code needed.
